name: CZ CELLxGENE Discover + Census
content: Harmonized h5ad collections and a TileDB-SOMA Census with unified tissue, cell_type, disease, development_stage, sex fields.
notes: First stop for mouse. No rat. Region and cell-class coverage below is computed from the Census.

name: Allen Brain Cell Atlas (AWS Open Data)
content: Whole mouse brain atlas: WMB-10Xv2 1.7M cells, WMB-10Xv3 2.3M cells, 10x Multiome 1,687 cells; 4.0M combined; MERFISH 3.9M cells (spatial).
access: open (license CC BY-NC 4.0 on the WMB-10Xv2 page)
how: aws s3 sync --no-sign-request s3://allen-brain-cell-atlas/expression_matrices/WMB-10Xv2/20230630/ (104 GB); abc_atlas_access package
notes: Region labels in cell metadata; CELLxGENE also hosts it.

name: Allen Brain Map RNA-seq data portal
content: Mouse: Whole Cortex and Hippocampus 10x (2020), Whole Cortex and Hippocampus SMART-seq (2019), V1 and ALM SMART-seq (2018), ACA and MOp SMART-seq (2018).
notes: SMART-seq sets are plate-based (deeper per cell).

name: NeMO Archive (BICCN/BICAN)
content: BRAIN Initiative raw and processed omics. Langlieb 2023 raw 10x snRNA-seq (25 TB, open); Yao 2021 isocortex/hippocampus raw (15 TB, open).
access: mixed: many collections open, some restricted
notes: Raw FASTQ scale; look for processed matrices elsewhere (CELLxGENE, Broad SCP) first.

name: Broad Single Cell Portal
content: Study pages with processed matrices: SCP97 (Campbell arcuate), SCP263 (Ximerakis aging brain), SCP332 (BICCN cerebellum CB-G9), SCP795 (Kozareva cerebellum).
how: Sign in, Download tab, or bulk download curl command

name: NCBI GEO
content: Primary home for author deposits; the only practical source for most rat datasets.
notes: Processed-matrix formats vary (mtx, h5, rds, csv).

name: NCBI SRA / ENA
content: Raw reads behind GEO series (SRP/PRJNA accessions).

name: EMBL-EBI Single Cell Expression Atlas
content: Uniformly reprocessed single-cell experiments, e.g. E-GEOD-121891 (Tepe olfactory bulb, 39,850 cells).
how: Experiment page Download tab (normalised counts, clusters)
notes: Good for quick processed matrices of GEO studies.

name: ArrayExpress / BioStudies
content: E-MTAB and mirrored E-GEOD series.

name: DropViz
content: Saunders 2018 Drop-seq atlas of nine adult mouse brain regions, browsable by region and cell type.
how: Web explorer; raw and processed via GEO GSE116470

name: mousebrain.org (Linnarsson lab)
content: Zeisel 2018 mouse nervous system atlas (CNS and PNS), loom files.

name: Bioconductor scRNAseq (ExperimentHub)
content: One-line loaders for many published single-cell datasets including several mouse brain sets.
notes: List what is current before relying on a given dataset.

name: UCSC Cell Browser
content: Hosted browsable single-cell datasets with downloadable matrices.

name: BrainPalmSeq (UBC)
content: Aggregator browser for brain RNA-seq: Kozareva cerebellum, DropViz, thalamus, hypothalamus (Chen 2017), striatum, amygdala, hippocampus.
notes: Discovery aid, not a download source.

name: Thalamoseq (Janelia)
content: Thalamic nuclei transcriptomes (Phillips 2019).

name: Cambridge Apollo repository (HypoMap)
content: HypoMap: 384,925-cell integrated mouse hypothalamus atlas as Seurat 4 RDS.

name: Tabula Muris / Tabula Muris Senis
content: Whole-mouse organ atlases including brain, FACS Smart-seq2 and 10x, ages 1 to 30 months.

name: Mouse Cell Atlas
content: Microwell-seq atlas of mouse organs incl. brain.

name: Zenodo / Figshare / Mendeley Data / Dryad
content: Author-deposited h5ad, rds, loom files, often the best processed form.
how: DOI in each paper's data availability statement

name: Brain Image Library (spatial)
content: Spatial/MERFISH data (e.g. Zhuang lab whole-brain). Out of scope for now (single-cell dissociated only).

name: OmicsDI
content: Cross-repository index (GEO, ArrayExpress, PRIDE) useful for quick metadata lookups.
